categories_thin: Tire shops - only one independent (A & J Tire Shop) surfaced; the rest of the Somerset tire market is chain or brand-franchised and excluded by the brief.
Towing - few operators list a Franklin Township address; most are county-wide or based in neighbouring towns, and the NJ towing roster is published per-municipality rather than as a bulk list.
Self-storage - the township market is almost entirely national chains (CubeSmart, Extra Space), which the brief excludes, so nothing was listed.
Body shops - only two Franklin Township facilities appeared in the state's licensed auto-body list slices that could be read; more likely exist along the Route 27 corridor.

Septic and well - local firms mostly operate out of Montgomery, Hillsborough or Bound Brook and only list Franklin Township as a service area, so they were recorded with 'serves' notes rather than as confirmed in-town businesses.
Manufacturing/machine shops were seen (Betar, Csepli Machine, Rendas Tool & Die, Jersey Metalworks) but belong to group D, not group C, so they were left out of this brief.
caveats: Franklin Township covers the Somerset (08873), Franklin Park (08823), Middlebush, East Millstone, Griggstown and part of Kingston mailing addresses; entries were kept only where the listing address fell in one of those, and a handful are flagged 'township unconfirmed'.
The entire township sits inside the 10-mile radius from central Milltown, so no part of the zone was dropped on distance grounds.
Many directory-sourced entries show only one listing; the triage team should confirm they still trade before outreach.

National and regional chains, franchises and brand-franchised locations were deliberately excluded (e.g. Roto-Rooter, SERVPRO, ServiceMaster, Chem-Dry, MaidPro, ADT, Home Genius Exteriors, Universal Windows Direct, The Brothers That Just Do Gutters, CubeSmart, Extra Space, Goodyear, Mavis, Pink Zebra Moving, Viking Pest, Terminix, Lawn Doctor).
Two entries (Binsky Home Service, Budd Van Lines) are larger multi-branch regional firms rather than single-shop independents; they are included with a note so an analyst can decide.
data_gaps: YellowPages, BBB, BuildZoom, Superpages, Cylex, LocalSolution, MapQuest, ShowMeLocal, AllPages and the Township of Franklin's own business directory (franklintwpnj.org) all blocked automated access (403 / Cloudflare / Akamai bot checks); their bulk lists could not be read directly and entries were captured only from search-result summaries.
The Internet Archive (including the Wayback CDX API) was offline, so cached township directory pages could not be recovered.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API endpoints did not respond (fetch failure / timeout), so no OSM bulk extraction was possible.
Google Maps served only a limited (~10 result) view per query without signing in and refused to paginate, so map-based coverage is a sample per category rather than exhaustive.
ShowMeLocal presented a 'checking your browser' bot challenge, which was not bypassed per task rules.
The NJ MVC auto-body facility PDF could only be read in slices, so the licensed auto-body list for 08873/08823 may be incomplete.
